name: Gorbold Steelhand
summary: In Auberdine, Gorbold Steelhand keeps trade moving along Darkshore’s coast. The dwarven merchant brings goods from far across the Great Sea for travelers, crafters, and night elves.

sections.title: A Dwarven Trader in Kalimdor
sections.body: Gorbold Steelhand brings Ironforge trade to Auberdine. Night elves populate much of northern Kalimdor, so Alliance outposts depend on merchants who cross the Great Sea. Gorbold works alongside the kaldorei, selling trade goods, reagents, crafting supplies, and tools. Travelers come to him as they prepare to explore Darkshore’s dangerous shores and forests.

sections.title: Maritime Ventures
sections.body: Gorbold Steelhand watches the perilous waters off Auberdine as closely as his stock. Reefs along Darkshore have swallowed Alliance vessels, and lost cargo draws the merchant’s interest. Travelers who dive into the deep ocean may find him eager to hear about salvage and lost logs from sunken wrecks.

faq.answer: Gorbold Steelhand is a dwarven merchant in Auberdine, the coastal port of Darkshore.
Gorbold Steelhand sells general trade supplies, crafting ingredients, gathering tools, and reagents such as vials and thread for tradesfolk passing through Auberdine.

faq.q: Why is an Ironforge dwarf living in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Auberdine connects Kalimdor to the Eastern Kingdoms as an Alliance transit hub. Dwarves travel there for commerce, exploration, and support of allied night elf operations.

aliases: deep ocean vast sea quest giver
faq.answer: Yes. Gorbold Steelhand directs adventurers to recover lost ship cargo from sunken wreckage off Darkshore in 'Deep Ocean, Vast Sea'.

angles.text: As a dwarf, seeing Gorbold Steelhand in Darkshore’s misty, nocturnal surroundings can remind you of home in Ironforge.
As an Alliance member, you can see Gorbold Steelhand helping eastern Alliance races and night elves keep trade flowing across the Great Sea.
